identified_issues.description: assignedTo parameter in createTask is not actually used (people array is empty)
Example usage in main() auto-executes on import
No validation that required environment variables are set
updateTask overwrites entire Notes field instead of appending

functional_requirements.requirement: System shall create tasks in Notion database with all required properties
acceptance_criteria: Task created with title, status, assignee, and notes
Task ID returned upon successful creation
Error handled gracefully with meaningful message

functional_requirements.requirement: System shall update existing task status and metadata
System shall retrieve tasks based on filters
System shall support bulk task operations
acceptance_criteria: Create multiple tasks in single operation

functional_requirements.requirement: System shall validate configuration before execution
System shall provide CLI for manual operations
System shall handle Notion API errors gracefully

non_functional_requirements.requirement: System shall have error recovery mechanisms
